name: aphelion
description: An offline, physically accurate, real-time model of the solar system.

scripts.assets: node scripts/fetch-assets.ts && bash scripts/convert-textures.sh && node scripts/fetch-assets.ts --only=manifest
scripts.assets:textures: node scripts/fetch-assets.ts --only=textures && bash scripts/convert-textures.sh && node scripts/fetch-assets.ts --only=manifest
scripts.assets:light: node scripts/fetch-assets.ts --skip-usgs --tier=high && bash scripts/convert-textures.sh && node scripts/fetch-assets.ts --only=manifest
